text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki captivated the crowd at the 
Yasuda Kinen as well. While fan 
expectations surged endlessly, the Trainer 
felt something was off with her running 
form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With growing anxiety, the Trainer rushes 
to her side. However, Fuji Kiseki had 
already left for home. Hishi Amazon 
worries about Fuji Kiseki as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next race is the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
Before that, however, the Trainer felt 
they needed to find out what had happened 
with Fuji Kiseki.
